title: Lennar Celebrates Grand Opening of The Oaks at Vacation Destination Eclectic Near Alabama's Beautiful Lake Martin
summary: Lennar, one of the nation's leading homebuilders, today announced the grand opening of The Oaks at Eclectic, a new single-family home community just minutes from Lake Martin in the vacation...
body_markdown:
ECLECTIC, Ala.


, Sept. 4, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Lennar, one of the nation's leading homebuilders, today announced the grand opening of[The Oaks at Eclectic](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4767219-1&h=3875603979&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lennar.com%2Fnew-homes%2Falabama%2Fbirmingham%2Feclectic%2Fthe-oaks-at-eclectic&a=The+Oaks+at+Eclectic) , a new single-family home community just minutes from Lake Martin in the vacation destination of Eclectic, AL. Prospective residents are invited to tour the professionally decorated model home and enjoy complimentary food and refreshments on Friday, Sept. 4, from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m.


"Lake Martin draws generations of vacationing families every summer, and now homebuyers seeking that lake-town lifestyle year-round can make Eclectic their permanent home," said Jayson Williams, Lennar Birmingham Division President. "Lennar's single-story floorplans suit every stage of life, from raising kids to retirement. The Oaks at Eclectic is for those who want to maximize living space, minimize upkeep, and spend more time outside in one of central Alabama's most desirable recreational areas."


The festivities will take place at The Oaks at Eclectic Welcome Home Center, at 25 Overcup Drive. Interested attendees are encouraged to RSVP[here](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4767219-1&h=896568079&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lennar.com%2Fnew-homes%2Falabama%2Fbirmingham%2Fevent%2Fbhmlen_theoaksateclectic_go&a=here) .


The Oaks at Eclectic's four home designs range from 1,248 to 1,852 square feet with three to four bedrooms and two bathrooms. Open-concept layouts connect the family room, kitchen, and dining area to create a bright, naturally lit living space, while spacious owner's suites include walk-in closets. Every home comes with a washer and dryer, and select plans also offer covered patios and expansive Great Rooms for enhanced indoor-outdoor living and entertaining. Pricing starts in the $200,000s.


Every home offers Lennar's signature[Everything's Included®](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4767219-1&h=829051591&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4083698-1%26h%3D1485268572%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.lennar.com%252Fproductsandservices%252Feverythings-included%26a%3DEverything%2527s%2BIncluded%25C2%25AE&a=Everything%27s+Included%C2%AE) program, where the homebuilder's most popular features and finishes are built into the base price of the home. At Vinova, this includes stainless steel appliances, kitchen appliances, quartz countertops, designer-selected cabinetry, luxury vinyl plank flooring and a host of other carefully curated interior touches and designer fixtures.


Located just 15 minutes from Lake Martin, The Oaks at Eclectic places residents close to one of Alabama's premier outdoor recreation destinations, with easy access to boating, fishing, hiking and waterfront dining. Just minutes away, the charming downtown district of Eclectic is home to locally owned shops, restaurants and small-town events. Additional shopping, restaurants and entertainment in Wetumpka and Montgomery are just a short drive away.


For more information on these new home opportunities, call (256) 860-8308 or visit[the community website](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4767219-1&h=1354281711&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.lennar.com%2Fnew-homes%2Falabama%2Fbirmingham%2Feclectic%2Fthe-oaks-at-eclectic&a=the+community+website) .


**About Lennar Corporation** Lennar Corporation, founded in 1954, is one of the nation's leading builders of quality homes for all generations. Lennar builds affordable, move-up and active adult homes primarily under the Lennar brand name. Lennar's Financial Services segment provides mortgage financing, title and closing services primarily for buyers of Lennar's homes and, through LMF Commercial, originates mortgage loans secured primarily by commercial real estate properties throughout the United States. Lennar's Multifamily segment is a nationwide developer of high-quality multifamily rental properties. LENX drives Lennar's technology, innovation and strategic investments.
